title: How Much of the Incidental Hold Is Collected in Advance, Resort Lodging
content:
How much of a Resort Lodging unit type's incidental hold is collected in advance against incidentals turns on what else the household already holds with the collective for the season of the stay. Two kinds of holding are read: the household's dining plans under Mountain Dining Plans, and its rental agreements under Equipment Rental and Demo, each read for its standing and for the season it is held for.

Where the household holds both a dining plan standing active and a rental agreement standing confirmed for the season of the stay, nothing is collected in advance against incidentals.

Where the household holds either a dining plan standing active or a rental agreement standing confirmed for that season but not both, the known household share of the unit type's incidental hold is collected in advance against incidentals, that share being one half of it, or 50 percent of the published hold.

Where the household holds neither for that season, the whole of the unit type's incidental hold is collected in advance against incidentals.

| Dining plan standing active for the season | Rental agreement standing confirmed for the season | Collected in advance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | nothing |
| yes | no | one half of the unit type's incidental hold |
| no | yes | one half of the unit type's incidental hold |
| no | no | the whole of the unit type's incidental hold |

### Three hypothetical households, on a unit type whose incidental hold is taken here as 500.00 USD

A household holding a dining plan standing active for the season of the stay and a rental agreement standing confirmed for that season has nothing collected in advance against incidentals.

A household holding only the dining plan standing active for that season has 250.00 USD collected in advance, being 50 percent of the 500.00 USD hold.

A household holding neither for that season has the whole 500.00 USD collected in advance.
